messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Seeking assitance for intepretation of Niche Overlap
parts:
Hi Suresh,
For guidance on interpreting results, please see the relevant guidance texts. Wallace supplies information for each component and each module within the 'Component Guidance' and 'Module Guidance' tabs (to the left of the Map, Occurrence, and Results tabs). 
Niche overlap is available from the `ecospat` R-package, so you can also check their vignette for more information. The section on Niche overlap starts at 2.5.3.
https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ecospat/vignettes/vignette_ecospat_package.pdf

Hakan Gür, 1993-2007 yılları arasında lisans, yüksek lisans ve doktora öğrenimini Hacettepe Üniversitesi, Fen Fakültesi, Biyoloji Bölümü’nde tamamlamıştır. messages.subject: Re: Seeking assitance for intepretation of Niche Overlap
parts:
Hi Erica, 
Dr. Hakan Gür is correct- you can find WorldClim data on their website: https://www.worldclim.org/data/v1.4/worldclim14.html 
which can be downloaded and uploaded using the User-Specified module. You can also use the User-Specified for uploaded any other historical data. Also, the ecoClimate module allows access to the ecoClimate database which has past, present, & future climate data (see: DOI: https://doi.org/10.17161/bi.v10i0.4955 for more details).

If you have trouble downloading from these databases, it might mean their server is down, which happens temporarily but is usually fixed promptly.

Bethany Johnson
The Wallace Team
